titulo: Amazon (Apr 2022): $212.7 million CEO total pay, $32,855 median worker. Now the math.
descripcion:
From the archive: Apr 2022. Not today's news.
Amazon, Apr 14, 2022 (Amazon, proxy statement): "committed to the safety and well-being of our employees"
Amazon's proxy statement, dated April 14, 2022, reported its CEO's 2021 total pay as $212,701,169. It reported the median employee's 2021 total pay as $32,855.

Fiscal 2021: $212.7 million CEO total pay, fiscal 2021, proxy. total compensation of the CEO for 2021 as reported in the proxy; the proxy says nearly all of it is one restricted stock unit award granted on his promotion to CEO, vesting over 10 years.
The math: $212.7 million CEO total pay (2021) ÷ $32,855 median worker = about 6,474 CEO pay per median worker's annual pay.
The facts: $212.7 million CEO total pay (SEC EDGAR · Amazon, Apr 14, 2022). $32,855 total pay, 2021 (SEC EDGAR · Amazon, Apr 14, 2022). Nearly all of the $212,701,169 is one restricted stock unit award, granted on the CEO's promotion and vesting over 10 years, per the proxy. The proxy states the ratio as 1-to-6,474; the division gives 6,473.94, shown as 6,474.

Committed to employees, it said. Here is the pay column. (Our take.)

Sources:
- SEC EDGAR · Amazon, Apr 14, 2022: «We also aim to be Earth’s safest place to work and are committed to the safety and well-being of our employees.» and «Mr. Jassy’s 2021 annual total compensation as reported under SEC rules was $212,701,169» and «The 2021 annual total compensation of our median compensated employee (identified from all full- and part-time permanent and temporary employees worldwide, excluding our CEO) was $32,855» https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1018724/000110465922045572/tm223357-5_def14a.htm
